note: ENF-WHU holdout H0 negative 13 vs day 070
gate_reasons: basis match peak NCC 0.67104 <= frozen threshold 0.95531 for 300 s

argon_final.explanation: The 465.0 s audio-only recording contains a weak and noisy mains-hum signal, with a median frame quality of 5.74 dB, a trace standard deviation of 45.65 mHz across all harmonics, and a 0.084 fraction of frames reaching at least 10 dB. Testing the longest fitting calibrated window of 300 s starting at 0 s using the highest-SNR harmonics (4, 5, 6, and 7, with median SNRs of 10.72, 7.07, 8.05, and 8.56) yielded a valid frame fraction of 0.36 and a peak correlation (NCC) of 0.66101 against the 86350 s reference window. Testing the same 300 s window with only the strongest harmonic (harmonic 4, median SNR 10.72) produced a valid frame fraction of 0.33 and a peak NCC of 0.67104 (second peak 0.63899, margin 0.03206, z-score 3.64). Both correlation peaks fall far below the required 0.95531 threshold for a 300 s window and point to inconsistent candidate start offsets in the reference trace (14847.64 s versus 69438.95 s). Because the extracted ENF trace is too degraded to produce a statistically reliable match, the result is inconclusive.
argon_final.rationale: Both well-justified 300 s audio configurations—combining the cleanest harmonics [4, 5, 6, 7] (peak NCC 0.66101, valid frame fraction 0.36) and isolating the highest-SNR harmonic [4] (SNR 10.72, peak NCC 0.67104, valid frame fraction 0.33)—fall far short of the 0.95531 frozen threshold and yield unrelated candidate offsets (14847.64 s vs 69438.95 s). Because overall recording quality is uniformly weak across the 465.0 s duration (median frame quality 5.74 dB, 0.084 fraction of frames >= 10 dB, trace std 45.65 mHz), further window or harmonic permutations would only increase false-match risk without overcoming the low signal quality.
what_would_change: A cleaner audio source with median frame quality above 5.74 dB, a fraction of frames at or above 10 dB higher than 0.084, and a valid frame fraction above 0.36 so that a 300 s window achieves a peak NCC above the 0.95531 threshold.
Agreement between harmonic configurations on the implied media start offset within the 86350 s reference trace, rather than divergent offsets like 14847.64 s and 69438.95 s.
Availability of a video modality with periodic lamp flicker to supplement the noisy audio trace.
